source_snapshot.procedure: Load ras_enable=1; retain UMC precheck; run block5/subtype1/type4 mode2 ECRC TX then mode3 ECRC RX.
source_snapshot.criteria: Each succeeds and Table3.14-defined uncorrectable AER/driver result is observed.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL conflates severities and omits containment/phase stop rules.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Preserves both ECRC directions and requires Table3.14, AER containment and recovery.

old_problem: Implicit PCIe target, proprietary Table3.14 mode semantics, endpoint/root-port severity and containment oracle, phase recovery and no-retry recovery are unapproved.
disposition_reason: Uncorrectable ECRC may trigger DPC, reset or device loss whose acceptability is platform-specific. ED-16 requires an authoritative containment and Recovery contract, while ED-19 requires TX and RX to retain separate evidence; mere injection success is never PASS.
decision_basis: Directly read Reliability row201 all18 XLSX cells and history2582.
Preserved separate mode2 ECRC TX and mode3 ECRC RX stimuli, Table3.14, endpoint/root-port AER and recovered-state evidence.
Required full recovery and rebaseline after TX before any RX authorization; retained UMC query only as ancillary precheck.
No injection, module change, reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD PCIe uncorrectable ECRC TX and RX containment validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the approved platform contains and recovers independently from ECRC transmit and receive events with the exact expected AER/DPC/reset behavior.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras version/hash/license and matching driver
AMD GPU RAS Tool guide Table3.14 or signed equivalent
GPU UUID/OAM/BDF, endpoint/root-port and downstream link map
Expected endpoint/root-port AER severity, DPC/reset/device-loss contract
Approved PCIe/GPU/OOB recovery and phase authorization
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records endpoint/root-port AER, enumeration and link baseline, validates Table3.14 and recovery, runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 5 -s 1 -t 4 -m 2` once, captures TX containment and completes approved recovery/rebaseline; only after a healthy explicit gate runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 5 -s 1 -t 4 -m 3` once and repeats RX containment and recovery evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Each separately authorized direction produces the exact approved uncorrectable AER/driver/containment state and ends in the specified recovered state with no unresolved host hang, device loss, link degradation or continuing storm.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both directions independently meet their Table3.14 severity/containment oracle and recovered-state criteria. Injection success alone, unexpected fatality, unresolved device loss, missing phase evidence or bypassed recovery fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle recoverable PCIe SUT with OOB access and explicit uncorrectable-injection approval.
Approve target, severity, DPC/reset expectations and recovery before TX.
Do not authorize RX until TX recovery and complete rebaseline pass.
One attempt per phase; no automatic retry, reset or power cycle.
expected_evidence: Pre/post endpoint and root-port AER/status/header fields
Separate mode2 TX evidence and containment timeline
Approved recovery/rebaseline then separate mode3 RX evidence
Final enumeration, link width/speed, driver and host/BMC health
test_case.recovery: On host hang, wrong severity, device loss or containment mismatch, preserve evidence and use only preapproved OOB/PCIe/GPU/reboot recovery; verify endpoint/root-port status and full platform health before any new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: Primary source consistently specifies uncorrectable ECRC TX mode2 and RX mode3; DeepSeek's mixed-severity wording is a historical review defect.
